button-group.$description: ButtonGroup's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--button-group-<name>) on the page, a container or one group, and everything inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

gap.$description: Space between buttons when not attached (8px).

overlap.$description: How much attached buttons overlap, so their borders make one line (1px, the button border).

divider.$description: Strength of the edge between two attached solid (primary) buttons, in their text color (40%). Set 0% for none.
